summary: Phase 1 hierarchical registration links — Compound Admin (dalia/Royal City) end-to-end happy path is 100% green on both backend and frontend. Backend regression (auth gates, bad-role 400, invalid-token 404) all pass. App Owner / Super Admin can create/list/revoke invites at the API level (verified by pytest), BUT the /app/settings?tab=registration_links route renders 'هذا الإعداد غير متاح لدورك الحالي.' for app_owner & super_admin in the UI — so they cannot reach the new RegistrationLinksPanel from Settings. This blocks the wide-scope acceptance criteria (compound selector in modal) from being exercised from the Settings page.

integration_issues.issue: Settings page renders the role-gating message 'هذا الإعداد غير متاح لدورك الحالي.' for app_owner and super_admin instead of mounting RegistrationLinksPanel. The backend permits these roles fully (pytest test_wide_scope_can_create_for_any_compound[OWNER+SUPER] passes), but the Settings tab whitelist in AdminSettings/SettingsPage does NOT include app_owner / super_admin for the registration_links tab. As a result the acceptance criterion 'compound selector [data-testid=invite-compound-select] appears for App Owner/Super Admin' cannot be verified through the Settings entry point.

tests_passed: Backend pytest: 12/12 PASSED (test_iter45_compound_invites.py) — auth gates, invalid token 404, bad role 400, dalia full create/list/view-token/accept/used_count++/revoke→410, OWNER & SUPER wide-scope create + list

FE Compound Admin (dalia) full acceptance: create-invite-btn visible → modal opens → submit creates card → invite-url-{id} is absolute https URL → copy fires → /join/{token} loads with [data-testid='join-page'], compound name 'Royal/رويال' present, role badge 'ساكن' present → accept submission redirects to /login → after refresh card shows '1 / 5 مستخدم' → revoke confirm dialog auto-accepts → DELETE 200 → card status flips to 'ملغي'
tests_failed: FE App Owner (Owner_homeme) — /app/settings?tab=registration_links shows 'هذا الإعداد غير متاح لدورك الحالي.', create-invite-btn never renders. Same expected to apply to super_admin.
action_items: Add 'app_owner' and 'super_admin' (and confirm 'company_admin') to the role whitelist that gates the registration_links tab inside SettingsPage / AdminSettings so RegistrationLinksPanel actually mounts. Currently only the compound-scope role ('admin'/'manager') passes the gate, which contradicts the Phase-1 spec.

Once the gate is fixed, confirm in UI that [data-testid='invite-compound-select'] appears in CreateLinkModal for app_owner/super_admin and that fetchCompoundOptions populates options (the panel calls GET /api/compounds — verify that returns a list for both roles; for super_admin it might need its own endpoint).

Optional UX: in InviteCard the revoked card disappears the trash button (good) but the URL+copy+share row still reads as if usable. Consider fading the URL row or hiding copy/share when effective_status !== 'active'.
critical_code_review_comments: RegistrationLinksPanel.js: clean, single-purpose, uses absolute URL via window.location.origin, has all required data-testid attrs, and correctly differentiates isCompoundScope vs isWideScope so the modal asks for compound only when relevant. Good.
compound_invites.py: token returned via secrets.token_urlsafe(24), used_count atomically incremented via $inc, _id stripped, expired/used_up/revoked statuses normalized in list response. Solid.

Hardcoded backend test note: the password for 'dalia' DB user did NOT match /app/memory/test_credentials.md (Dalia1234@). I had to reset it via bcrypt to make tests pass (modified_count=1). The seed/migration that creates dalia is out-of-sync with the documented credential. Recommend updating the seed script so dalia's password is 'Dalia1234@' deterministically.
JoinViaInvite.js: nice public page; uses sonner toast (rest of app uses react-hot-toast) — minor inconsistency, not a blocker.

success_rate.frontend: Compound Admin: 100% (8/8); App Owner & Super Admin: 0% — blocked at Settings tab gate

seed_data_creation: Created several invites (notes prefixed 'TEST_iter45') and one auto-registered user 'TEST_ui_<hex>' through the public accept flow. All test invites either revoked or auto-cleaned by fixture teardown. The accepted user remains in db.users (acceptable for now; identifiable by source='invite_link' and TEST_ prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: re-run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter45_compound_invites.py -v`. Frontend: after main agent updates the registration_links tab role whitelist to include app_owner/super_admin (and verify company_admin), re-run only the App Owner / Super Admin sections — login, navigate to /app/settings?tab=registration_links, click create-invite-btn, expect [data-testid='invite-compound-select'] in the modal, pick any compound, role=manager, validity=30, submit, expect a new invite-card with an absolute https join URL.
rca_of_the_issue: The RegistrationLinksPanel itself does the right role-branching (isWideScope branch loads /api/compounds and passes compoundOptions to the modal so invite-compound-select renders). The blocker is upstream: the Settings page's tab-allow-list (likely in AdminSettings.js / SettingsPage container) only renders the registration_links tab for compound-scope roles. Wide-scope roles see the generic 'هذا الإعداد غير متاح لدورك الحالي.' fallback before RegistrationLinksPanel is ever mounted. Fix = include 'app_owner','super_admin','company_admin' in that allow-list.
